notes: URGENT FIX for version 2.6.66. In 2.6.66 an internal module was missing from the build, which caused every order attempt to fail with an internal error logged as 'Loop error' in the activity log. Version 2.6.66 could not place trades. Please update immediately. No trades were placed incorrectly and no positions were affected; the bot simply could not enter. This release restores order placement and includes the same time-handling and entry-safety improvements intended for 2.6.66: broker server time is converted to UTC internally, the cooldown countdown in the activity log is corrected, and orders are checked for a tradable symbol, a fresh price quote, and excessive price drift before being sent.
